body.label: Effect
body.html: Choose one creature within 5 units. On a success against Harmony, deal 1 Necrotic damage and make it Withered.

surges.html: When this Rite's next Echo resolves, it may affect one additional eligible target.
Increase this Rite's Echo Limit by 1; when its Echo burns dice, it burns 1 additional die.

rider.title: HEX RITE
rider.html: After resolving this Action, you may establish this Rite. Trigger: The hexed creature fails an Action or Reaction. Echo: It burns 1 die on its next Action.
